## 2026-07-21 16:52 UTC -- Sweep 2026-07-21b: inbox note PR #72 CI failing (rustdoc redundant link) (sweep)

## 2026-07-21 16:44 UTC -- #11 implemented: draft PR #72 (sweep)

Implemented #11 (typed stashes workflow helper) on branch feat/issue-11-typed-stashes, draft PR #72.

Added src/stashes.rs: Repository::stashes() -> StashOps<'_>, workflow-gated. StashEntry { index, branch, subject, sha } parsed from `git stash list -z --format=%gd%x1f%H%x1f%gs` (NUL records, unit-separated fields). list/push/pop/apply/drop/clear delegate to the existing StashCommand. Reflog-subject parser handles "WIP on <b>:" and "On <b>:", preserves ": " in subjects (splitn), keeps "(no branch)" verbatim. Wired into lib.rs under the workflow feature + feature-table doc.

Tests: 5 unit tests (parser + stash_ref), module doctest (no_run), 2 real-git integration tests in tests/workflow.rs (push/list/pop roundtrip; apply/drop/clear). Integration tests use the crate's async commands, not std::process, per the macOS SIGCHLD flake note.

Checks all green: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings, cargo test --all-features (136 unit + doctests + integration), default-feature build compiles. PR left as draft per the approved action.

## 2026-07-21 16:39 UTC -- Sweep 2026-07-21: defer #44, propose #11 (sweep)

Backlog unchanged (18 open). Inbox empty. PRs: #67 draft (=#53 bisect, agent-claimed), #59 release.

Re-examined #44 (kill process group on timeout). Bug is real: `execute_internal` uses `cmd.output().await`; on `tokio::time::timeout` expiry the future is dropped and git's grandchildren (pack/askpass/hooks) orphan. BUT the fix is medium+, not small: needs a new dep (`libc` for `killpg`; crate currently has only 5 lean runtime deps), cross-platform cfg gating (Unix `process_group(0)` + Windows Job Object fallback), AND an inherently race-prone orphan-detection test that collides with the known macOS SIGCHLD reaper flake. Also labeled `enhancement`, not `bug`. Deferring #44 as a dep/design decision better suited to a human-scoped PR, not an unattended small sweep.

Proposing #11 instead: typed stashes workflow helper. Purely additive, sits on the existing `StashCommand` (push/pop/apply/drop/list/show/clear all present), parses `git stash list`, `workflow`-gated, no new deps, no flaky tests. Follows the `WorkflowOps` pattern in src/workflow.rs. Cleanest small well-scoped item.
